distributions.name: σ (\bar\nu_\mu n \to \mu^+ \pi^- n)
distributions.scale_note: a wide terminal bin is shown truncated (true edge in hi_true)
distributions.provenance: Bolognese:1979gf — total cross section vs anti-neutrino energy for charged-current single-pion (pi^-) production, Gargamelle propane-freon exposure at the CERN PS, corrected for nuclear reinteractions. Fig 2: the exclusive channel \bar\nu n \to \mu^+ \pi^- n; Fig 3: inclusive \pi^- exclusive production (N = neutron or proton). Each shown with and without the invariant-mass cut W_{piN} <= 1.4 GeV/c^2. DIGITIZED from Figs 2 and 3 (analytical plot-digitizer; each panel deskewed to remove scan tilt, then axis-aligned calibration; overlay-verified). The two M_A^2 theory curves (1.5 and 0.71 GeV^2/c^4) are excluded. From the paper.

digitization.note: Fig 2(a): total sigma(E) for the exclusive channel, no invariant-mass cut. Deskewed panel with our 6 extracted points + error bars overlaid; model curves excluded.
